name: Sorted Partition Isomorphism
description: Replaced the explicit "max of set 1 strictly less than min of set 2" constraint with a requirement that sorting the union of the two sets places all set 1 elements before all set 2 elements. This preserves the exact same mathematical properties (disjointness, strict precedence, and a total cardinality bound of p1+p2 <= T) but avoids the structural keywords ("strictly precede", "maximum", "minimum") that models use to trigger pigeonhole-principle heuristics.
